executiveSummary: Key developments with direct implications for industrial control systems (ICS), building automation, and critical infrastructure operations. Active, multi-sector targeting of Siemens S7 PLCs using AI-assisted tooling (snap7/S7comm) enables read/write memory operations and pre-positioning in U.S. water, energy, and manufacturing environments. CISA Advisory Water and Wastewater Systems (WWS) utilities report PLC lockouts via password/IP changes on internet-exposed devices, forcing manual operations and boil-water notices; urgent removal of direct exposure and credential resets are advised. CISA Alert A U.K. power plant suffered a multi-day outage due to cyberattack; media link potential Iran-aligned actors previously seen tampering with U.S. water utilities, underscoring real-world OT impact risk. View Article Pre-auth RCE in NetScaler ADC/Gateway (SAML) has public PoC; exploitation commonly plants web shells-perimeter compromise can enable rapid lateral movement toward OT. JPCERT Alert Nation-state activity increasingly routes through large covert proxy networks of compromised SOHO/IoT devices to obfuscate targeting of critical infrastructure, reducing the efficacy of IP-based defenses. Joint Advisory Multiple newly added KEV items (e.g., Cisco ASA/FTD, Windows AFD/WinSock LPE, Metabase SQLi) are being exploited; operators should accelerate patching and conduct compromise assessments. CISA KEV Update OT-relevant vulnerability clusters include OPC UA (Eclipse Milo authorization and crypto weaknesses), Delta PLC/Modbus exposures, EV charging RCE, and historian/deserialization issues-collectively increasing disruption risk if unpatched. Weekly CVE (OPC UA) Weekly CVE (Delta PLC) TrueConf server zero-days are being exploited to trojanize installers (PhantomCore/PhantomGraph) in energy/transport sectors-video infrastructure can serve as an enterprise foothold adjacent to OT. items: PRC-nexus operations leveraging covert SOHO/IoT proxy networks to pre-position against critical national infrastructure; heavy emphasis on edge-device exploitation and credential capture. Joint Advisory
Pro-Russia hacktivist collectives exploiting exposed VNC to manipulate OT HMIs, with documented "loss-of-view" and operational impacts in WWS and other sectors. Joint Advisory
Russian state-supported phishing and webmail exploitation (Zimbra) for strategic email theft and persistence across government, DIB, and energy targets. CISA Advisory
APT campaign (Head Mare) exploiting TrueConf server zero-days to deploy Windows backdoors and trojanize installers-observed in energy/transport/electronics. Vendor Research

relevance: Direct OT manipulation risk: Active campaigns against PLCs (Siemens S7; WWS lockouts) demonstrate credible capability to alter logic, disable alarms, and disrupt processes. CISA Advisory Perimeter-to-OT pathways: NetScaler RCE, TeamCity/Metabase exploitation, and Zimbra theft offer efficient initial access and persistence to reach engineering workstations and management controllers. JPCERT Weekly Protocol/middleware weaknesses: OPC UA role/crypto gaps (Eclipse Milo), Modbus-exposed PLCs, EVSE RCE, and historian deserialization flaws expand the blast radius if segmentation is weak. Weekly CVE Supply-chain and comms footholds: Exploited TrueConf servers and email platforms provide stealthy enterprise entry points adjacent to OT networks. Vendor Research

items: OPC UA (Eclipse Milo): Authorization bypasses, crypto weaknesses, DoS vectors in 0.6.0-1.1.4 can enable unauthorized method execution and service disruption in SCADA/DCS. Weekly CVE
Delta PLCs (Modbus TCP; resource exhaustion) and OpENer CIP stack DoS-prioritize segmentation and rate-limiting on OT gateways. Weekly CVE
EV charging (EVbee DC-80): Unauth web/Bluetooth admin, command injection, unsigned firmware, and OCPP abuse risks remote disruption. Weekly CVE
ibaPDA/ibaDatCoordinator: Unauthenticated deserialization RCE against historian/data acquisition deployments. Weekly CVE
Johnson Controls Simplex & Siemens Desigo BMS: Credential-in-memory exposure and BACnet DoS respectively; patch and segment BMS from ICS. ICS Advisory ICS Advisory
Johnson Controls Airwall (pre-4.1.0): Universal cryptographic key-urgent upgrade and key rotation required. ICS Advisory

descriptions: Initial Access: Exploitation of public-facing applications (NetScaler RCE; TeamCity/Metabase; Zimbra XSS/SQLi); Valid accounts via email theft and VPN auth-bypass (ATT&CK T1190, T1078).
Execution/Persistence: Web shell placement on appliances; trojanized installers (TrueConf); Windows services/CLSID persistence (PhantomCore/Graph) (T1505, T1543, T1546).
Privilege Escalation/Defense Evasion: BYOVD and early-boot abuse (BTR.sys research); LSASS dumping; MFA bypass and token replay (T1068, T1003, T1556).
Discovery/Lateral Movement: S7comm PUT/GET probing; Impacket tools; abuse of management planes (vCenter, ASA/FTD) (T1046, T1021).
Collection/Exfiltration: DNS/HTTPS exfiltration from webmail; cloud storage (OneDrive/Mega) (T1041, T1567).
Impact: PLC logic modification, alarm suppression, HMI manipulation causing "loss-of-view" and service disruption (ATT&CK for ICS: Inhibit Response Function, Manipulate Control).

outlook72h: Expect opportunistic exploitation of NetScaler ADC/Gateway where SAML is enabled and patches lag; prioritize exposure reduction and web-shell hunting. Operators with internet-exposed PLCs/HMIs remain at elevated risk of lockouts and logic changes; validate no OT assets are routable from the public internet. Watch for follow-on exploitation of OPC UA servers and EVSE/OCPP endpoints; tighten IDS signatures and apply virtual patching at gateways where needed. Increase monitoring on Zimbra, TeamCity, and Metabase for anomalous requests; audit admin changes, tokens, and web artifacts.
